slides.title: Study release and plate acceptance

Ines Alvarado checked run sheets, recovery entries and sample-card correspondence before release.
Bethany Rowcroft accepted the paired ranking for the screen gate; individual recovery remains visible.

slides.title: Methods and comparison basis
bullets: HLM/RLM stability: 0.5 mg/mL microsomal protein, compound at 1 µM.
Compare human and rat CLint in µL/min/mg; half-life in min.
RED PPB: human plasma, 4 h at 37 °C; read unbound fraction with recovery.
Censored half-lives remain limits. Binding alone does not establish permeability or in vivo clearance.

slides.title: Rennelwick progression decision
bullets: The initial stability ranking remained consistent at final release.
Prioritise the less bound amides for permeability work; retain the human/rat stability comparison beside that selection.
Recovery qualifies free-fraction interpretation and should accompany the permeability request.
Bethany Rowcroft to transfer paired listings under the same compound identifiers.
Permeability is the next screen gate; this study does not establish absorption.
